title: fix(metadata-protocol): the served type schemas no longer offer the keys the platform stamps
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVFUgB5fpb8vei5czKLWGBM)_

Fixes #35879

Clause-②: no (narrowing — a key leaves a served description; nothing a client could save before is refused)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the skills already say these keys are populated by the runtime (`objectstack-data` examples-objects) and tell an MCP client to write only the keys the contract shows (`objectstack-mcp-build` §3); the served contract now matches that instruction, so no skill text changes

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：Studio 和 AI 助手读到的「这类配置能写哪些字段」说明里，不再列出锁定状态、来源、所属包等 7 个由平台自己盖章的内部字段；保存时的接受与拒绝完全不变。
- 为什么做：AI 助手被要求「只写说明里列出的字段」，说明却把平台内部字段也列成可写，容易诱导它写进去。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某个界面不再显示这几个内部字段的输入框；它们本就不该由作者填写，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/unauthorable-nodes.ts`: the served-schema strip stage gains a second class. Besides a node no instance satisfies, it now withholds every key of the ADR-0010 protection envelope — `PLATFORM_STAMPED_KEYS`, read off `MetadataProtectionFields` (`_lock`, `_lockReason`, `_lockSource`, `_provenance`, `_packageId`, `_packageVersion`, `_lockDocsUrl`) — from any schema node's `properties` map, at every depth. Same position rule as the tombstones (only a `properties` entry, never a `$defs` name or a data keyword) and the same `required` veto (a required key stays).
- `protocol-meta-type-schema.ts`: comment on the import only; both derivation arms already pass through the strip.
- No change to `packages/spec`: the Zod schemas still declare the envelope, so a served body keeps re-parsing. No change to any save, publish or read path.
- `.changeset/35879-served-schema-platform-stamped-keys.md`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch.

Measured before the change (`origin/main` 7605e0c9, the real `getMetaTypes()`): 308 stamped-key nodes, 44 whole envelopes, across 33 served types — `object` at its root, in its `fields` entry schema and in a `$defs` union; `view` in each union arm.

A security item is with the owner seat.

## Tests

- `protocol.meta-types-unauthorable-columns.test.ts`, new describe `[#35879] the served types offer no key the platform stamps`:
  - control: the pre-strip derivation lists the whole envelope on `object` (root and field entry) and in more than one `view` arm;
  - dark: no served type lists a stamped key in any `properties` map at any depth;
  - lit: `object` keeps `name`/`label`/`fields`/`enable`, its field entry keeps `type`/`label`/`required`, `view` keeps its four arms;
  - over-drop guard: every stamped node in every derivation (both arms, every type) equals the envelope's own derived node and sits where all seven are spread, so a same-named property of another shape can never be what is withheld;
  - the Zod `object` schema still parses a body carrying `_packageId` / `_lock`.
- Same file, existing over-drop guard: a removal is now explained by either class; the exact `dashboard` tombstone ledger is kept on tombstones only.
- `protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts`: `retiredTopLevelCount` adds the stamped keys back, so every pinned declared total (`object` 52, `field` 89, …) stays the authority unchanged.
- `unauthorable-nodes.test.ts`, new describe: the key set is the seven envelope keys and frozen; dropped at the root and inside a record's entry; kept when required; never read outside a `properties` map.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts`: the MCP door's lean `contract: true` reply for `object` (root and the `fields/additionalProperties` drill) and `view` names no stamped key, with the control that `getMetadataTypeSchema('object')` still declares all seven.

## Acceptance notes

- Omit, not `readOnly`: the card allowed either. The converter's existing convention for "not an author's to write" is to drop the property (`retiredKey()` tombstones), and the MCP door's lean contract follows from the served schema without a second rule. Dropping a key from a description refuses nothing a save accepted before.
- `runtime` `typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit` is clean; its `check:test-typecheck` step reports TS2307 `@objectstack/driver-turso` in three untouched test files because that package was not in the locally built closure. Left to CI's typecheck job, which builds it.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.meta-types-unauthorable-columns.test.ts -t 35879` — five passing tests, the "dark" one asserting no served type lists `_lock` or any sibling.

- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `vitest run` at ddb6acbf: Test Files 372 passed, 9 skipped; Tests 23614 passed, 45 skipped. `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) exit 0.

At da349440: that file 16 passed; `-t 35879` 5 passed; `check-test-source-alias` exit 0.
